verdict.rationale: SvelteKit (Svelte's app framework) supports server load functions and client components, and one HN comment praises the clarity of what loads server vs client with the new routing/form actions structure, implying this workflow works well in practice. However, the evidence pack lacks first-party documentation of load functions, streaming/async data fetching, or explicit patterns for passing server-fetched data into interactive client components. Missing for 10: official docs on `load` functions and streaming promises, examples of async server-to-client data hydration, and independent technical corroboration beyond a single community anecdote.
